title: 25 Palworld Breeding Combos You Should Know | Verified Full Release Combos
description: 25 verified Palworld breeding combos for the full release, including Lunaris, Sibelyx, Blazehowl, Relaxaurus, Katress, Reptyro, Verdash, Incineram, Vanwyrm, Kingpaca, Azurobe and more. Every child is a different species from both parents.

sections.heading: 25 combos in one video
sections.script: Welcome back to HarryBeast Gaming. Today we have twenty five Palworld breeding combos in one video. Every single combo was checked against full release breeding data from two independent sources, and in every case the child is a completely different species from both parents. No variant tricks and no same species breeding. Just real combos you can set up on your Breeding Farm today. Quick reminder of how it works: put a male and a female on a Breeding Farm at your base, add Cake to the feed box, collect the egg, and hatch it in an Egg Incubator. Okay, let's go through the list, and keep an eye out for the cheap parents that show up again and again.

sections.heading: How to read these combos
sections.script: A quick note before we start. Palworld picks a child based on the hidden breeding power of the two parents, so the order of the parents does not matter. Breeding Ragnahawk with Relaxaurus is exactly the same as breeding Relaxaurus with Ragnahawk. Gender does matter though: you need one male and one female, so if you only have one gender of a parent, catch or hatch another one. And remember that you can stack good passive skills while you breed. If your parents have great passives, there is a chance the child will inherit them, which makes every combo in this list even more valuable. Right, here comes combo number one.

sections.heading: Combos one to five
sections.script: Let's start with five Pals that many players want early. Number 1: Lunaris. To get Lunaris, breed Clovee with Ragnahawk. Lunaris is a Neutral Pal. Clovee is an easy early catch, so this is a fast way to get Lunaris. Number 2: Sibelyx. To get Sibelyx, breed Nitewing with Ragnahawk. Sibelyx is an Ice Pal. Number 3: Blazehowl. To get Blazehowl, breed Kitsun with Ragnahawk. Blazehowl is a Fire Pal. Number 4: Relaxaurus. To get Relaxaurus, breed Blazehowl with Wumpo. Relaxaurus is a Dragon and Water Pal. Relaxaurus is a big, popular mount, and it shows up as a parent in lots of other combos. Number 5: Katress. To get Katress, breed Lifmunk with Reptyro. Katress is a Dark Pal. Lifmunk is one of the first Pals you will ever catch.

sections.heading: Combos six to ten
sections.script: Next, five more combos, including a few strong late game Pals. Number 6: Reptyro. To get Reptyro, breed Ragnahawk with Relaxaurus. Reptyro is a Fire and Ground Pal. Number 7: Verdash. To get Verdash, breed Nitemary with Relaxaurus. Verdash is a Grass Pal. Number 8: Icelyn. To get Icelyn, breed Incineram with Ragnahawk. Number 9: Broncherry. To get Broncherry, breed Kitsun with Relaxaurus. Broncherry is a Grass Pal. Number 10: Incineram. To get Incineram, breed Broncherry with Bushi. Incineram is a Fire and Dark Pal. Incineram is a great parent too, as you will see again and again in this list.

sections.heading: Combos eleven to fifteen
sections.script: This group is full of useful base workers and fighters. Number 11: Vaelet. To get Vaelet, breed Sweepa with Wumpo. Vaelet is a Grass Pal. Number 12: Bushi. To get Bushi, breed Incineram with Vanwyrm. Bushi is a Fire Pal. Number 13: Felbat. To get Felbat, breed Incineram with Kitsun. Felbat is a Dark Pal. Number 14: Vanwyrm. To get Vanwyrm, breed Bushi with Kitsun. Vanwyrm is a Fire and Dark Pal. Vanwyrm is a flying mount, so this combo gets you into the air early. Number 15: Elizabee. To get Elizabee, breed Grintale with Incineram. Elizabee is a Grass Pal.

sections.heading: Combos sixteen to twenty
sections.script: Now we are getting to some fan favourites. Number 16: Azurobe. To get Azurobe, breed Bushi with Grintale. Azurobe is a Water and Dragon Pal. Azurobe can carry you across water. Number 17: Foxcicle. To get Foxcicle, breed Cremis with Ragnahawk. Foxcicle is an Ice Pal. Number 18: Wixen. To get Wixen, breed Bristla with Incineram. Wixen is a Fire Pal. Number 19: Lovander. To get Lovander, breed Eikthyrdeer with Incineram. Lovander is a Neutral Pal. Number 20: Grintale. To get Grintale, breed Galeclaw with Kitsun. Grintale is a Neutral Pal.

sections.heading: Combos twenty one to twenty five
sections.script: And the final five combos on our list. Number 21: Sweepa. To get Sweepa, breed Leezpunk with Vanwyrm. Sweepa is an Ice Pal. Number 22: Kingpaca. To get Kingpaca, breed Killamari with Kitsun. Kingpaca is a Neutral Pal. Kingpaca is a huge ground mount. Number 23: Chillet. To get Chillet, breed Sparkit with Vanwyrm. Chillet is an Ice and Dragon Pal. Sparkit is another easy early catch. Number 24: Loupmoon. To get Loupmoon, breed Gobfin with Kitsun. Loupmoon is a Dark Pal. Number 25: Dumud. To get Dumud, breed Bushi with Lifmunk. Dumud is a Ground Pal. Lifmunk again, which makes this one really cheap.

sections.heading: Chain these combos together
sections.script: Here is a cool trick. Some combos on this list feed straight into each other, so you can build a breeding chain. Start with Kitsun and Relaxaurus to get Broncherry. Then breed that Broncherry with Bushi to get Incineram. Now breed Incineram with Vanwyrm and you get another Bushi, which is a handy way to get a second Bushi of the right gender. That same Incineram can also be bred with Kitsun for Felbat, with Grintale for Elizabee, or with Eikthyrdeer for Lovander. Here is another chain. Breed Ragnahawk with Relaxaurus to get Reptyro, and then breed that Reptyro with an easy Lifmunk to get Katress. One good pair of parents can open up a whole family of new Pals.

sections.heading: Tips before you start breeding
sections.script: A few tips to get the most out of this list. First, every egg costs one Cake, so cook a big batch before you start, and keep Mozzarina, Chikipi and Beegarde on your Ranch so the ingredients keep coming. Second, build more than one Breeding Farm, so you can run several of these combos at the same time. Third, the bigger and rarer the egg, the longer it takes to hatch, so build extra Egg Incubators in a closed room. And fourth, check the passive skills on your parents before you breed. A Pal with great passives is worth far more than one without, so breed from your best Pals whenever you can.

sections.heading: The best breeding partners
sections.script: Did you notice a pattern? A handful of Pals keep showing up as parents. Kitsun appears in seven different combos on this list, Incineram and Ragnahawk in six each, Bushi in four, and Relaxaurus and Vanwyrm in three each. That makes them some of the best Pals to keep in your Palbox purely for breeding. If you have both a male and a female of each, you can unlock a huge part of this list without catching anything new. Lifmunk, Sparkit, Clovee and Gobfin are also worth keeping, because they are easy to catch and they lead to strong children like Katress, Dumud, Lunaris, Chillet and Loupmoon.

sections.heading: Which combo is your favourite
sections.script: That is twenty five verified breeding combos, from easy early game Pals like Dumud and Chillet to big mounts like Relaxaurus, Kingpaca and Azurobe, and strong fighters like Bushi, Incineram and Blazehowl. Every one of them can be set up on a Breeding Farm today. Save this video so you can come back to it while you plan your Breeding Farm, and if it helped you, hit like and subscribe to HarryBeast Gaming. We post new Palworld breeding combos and breeding chains all the time. Tell us in the comments which Pal you want us to find a combo for next, and good luck with your eggs, Tamers!
